name: distilcode
description: DistilCode for Codex: persistent per-repo codebase memory, rtk-compacted shell output, and ponytail/caveman modes shared with the DistilCode CLI and the Claude Code plugin

interface.longDescription:
DistilCode cuts what Codex spends on context.

- Shell output compaction: commands run through rtk, which trims their output before it reaches the model.
- Codebase memory: a per-repo overview and feature map that survives sessions, loaded at session start and given to the explorer subagent. Off until you enable it for a repo.
- Ponytail mode (on by default): reuse what exists and write the shortest working diff.
- Caveman mode (off by default): compressed replies that keep every technical fact.

Modes and memory are shared with the DistilCode CLI and the Claude Code plugin. The plugin sends no data anywhere; its only download is the pinned rtk release from GitHub, checked against its sha256 checksums.
